sourceBinding.treeVerificationBoundary: Each of the five actual checkout SHAs was independently read from its original git log -1 output. The root performed the immutable Git commit API tree/parent verification; this reader reused it rather than issuing a duplicate API query.

method: Sum only the full retained ##[group]pnpm test:* output groups using the canonical runner's #/ℹ tests/pass/fail/skipped/todo/cancelled summaries. Streamed [db-runner ...] previews are excluded, so no test is double-counted. Multiple node invocations in one package script are retained and summed.
